name: FactCheck-Bench
why_it_matters: Newsrooms need to verify statistics and claims against authoritative sources, and this benchmark probes whether LLMs can decompose, retrieve, and adjudicate factual claims end-to-end.
task_shape: Given a claim, models must decompose it into checkworthy sub-claims, retrieve supporting evidence, and label each as supported, refuted, or unverifiable with citations.
signals: Provides a fine-grained, multi-step evaluation pipeline that mirrors how reporters actually fact-check statistics.
Coverage skews to general web claims rather than specialized government database lookups, so domain-specific statistical verification may be underrepresented.
